name.en: Desk Fan 12-Inch with 3 Speeds and Oscillation, White, Quiet 5-Blade Design, Tilting Head, Sturdy Square Base with Push Buttons, for Bedroom, Office and Living Room

description.en: A quiet five-blade desk fan with three speeds and side-to-side oscillation. The head tilts to aim the air, and the square base keeps it steady.
description.pt-BR: Ventilador de mesa silencioso de cinco pás, com três velocidades e oscilação. A cabeça inclina para direcionar o vento, e a base quadrada deixa tudo firme.
